description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to the DU manager in a 5G RAN software, including event handling, configuration, metrics aggregation, and control of the DU layer.

classes.name: du_manager_mac_event_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling external MAC events such as UL CCCH messages and C-RNTI CE indications.

classes.name: du_manager_mac_metric_aggregator
classes.description: Interface for aggregating MAC layer metrics reports from the DU.

classes.name: du_manager_configurator
classes.description: Interface for managing DU configuration tasks, including UE context management and connection handling.

classes.name: du_manager_interface_query
classes.description: Interface for querying DU manager state, such as number of UEs.

classes.name: du_manager_time_mapper_accessor
classes.description: Interface to access the DU MAC time-slot mapper.

classes.name: du_manager_controller
classes.description: Interface for controlling the DU manager's lifecycle, including start and stop.

classes.name: du_manager_interface
classes.description: Main interface combining all DU manager functionalities for external use.

methods.name: handle_ul_ccch_indication
methods.description: Handles the arrival of an UL CCCH message.

methods.name: handle_crnti_ce_indication
methods.description: Handles Msg3 C-RNTI CE detection indication.

methods.name: aggregate_mac_metrics_report
methods.description: Processes a MAC metrics report for aggregation.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task, either DU-wide or UE-specific.

methods.name: handle_f1c_connection_loss
methods.description: Handles F1-C connection loss event.

methods.name: find_unused_du_ue_index
methods.description: Finds an unused UE index in the DU.

methods.name: handle_f1_reset_request
methods.description: Handles F1 reset requests for UEs.

methods.name: handle_cu_context_update_request
methods.description: Handles context update requests from CU.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_creation
methods.description: Creates a new UE context in the DU.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_update
methods.description: Updates UE context in the DU.

methods.name: handle_ue_delete_request
methods.description: Deletes a UE context from the DU.

methods.name: handle_ue_drb_deactivation_request
methods.description: Deactivates DRB activity for a UE.

methods.name: handle_ue_reestablishment
methods.description: Transfers resources during UE reestablishment.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Confirms UE configuration application.

methods.name: get_positioning_handler
methods.description: Retrieves the UE positioning handler.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the DU manager.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the DU manager, blocking until completion.

methods.name: get_metrics_aggregator
methods.description: Returns the metrics aggregator instance.

methods.name: get_subframe_time_mapper
methods.description: Provides access to the MAC subframe time mapper.

methods.name: nof_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of UEs managed.
